hook: Hurricane Ian left them stranded with a little dog.
narration: He rode the basket up out of a flooded street with the dog in his arms.
Hurricane Ian had just hit Sanibel, Florida, and the water was still standing in the streets.
A Coast Guard swimmer from Air Station Miami found him, an older woman, and a little white dog.
She went up in the basket. [short pause] It's a cage, so nobody can slip out on the way up.
outcome: The Miami crew lifted both of them and the dog out of the flood.
title: Dog rides rescue basket after Ian
description:
A Coast Guard MH-65 Dolphin aircrew from Air Station Miami rescued two people and a dog stranded on Sanibel, Florida, after Hurricane Ian on Sept. 29, 2022.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 2nd Class Tyler Kilbane, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/859101/coast-guard-crew-rescues-2-people-1-dog-around-sanibel-florida
